title: N-transform and factorization of the DN-map
summary: Let $(Ω,g)$ be a smooth compact 3D Riemannian manifold with the smooth boundary $Γ$, $τ(x):={\rm dist\,}(x,Γ)$, $x\inΩ$; $Ω^τ:=\{x\inΩ\,|\,\,{\rm dist\,}(x,Γ) 0, $$ where $P^τ$ are the projections in $\mathscr P$ onto the subspaces $\mathscr P^τ:=\{h\in\mathscr P\,|\,\,{\rm supp\,}h\subset\overline{Ω^τ}\}$. We show that $N$ is a unitary operator. Let $p=p^f(x)$ be a solution to the Dirichlet problem: $Δ_g p=0$ in $Ω\setminusΓ$, $p=f$ on $Γ$.
